description: Export one of the user's Canva designs (designId or its Canva link) and save the files into the Hermoso Library, ready to post, schedule or use as ad creative. format png (default), jpg, mp4 or gif (pdf and pptx return Canva's 24-hour download link instead of a Library file); pages [1,3] for some pages; quality = 1-100 for JPG or e.g. vertical_1080p for MP4 (defaults follow the design's shape); proQuality:true for Canva's pro quality (fails on unlicensed premium elements). Free.

format.description: png (default), jpg, mp4 or gif saved to the Library; pdf and pptx return a 24-hour download link

height.description: output height in pixels, 40 to 25000; PNG and JPG only

pages.description: page numbers to export, e.g. [1, 3]; omit for all pages

proQuality.description: true requests Canva pro quality; fails on unlicensed premium elements

quality.description: JPG: 1 to 100. MP4: a preset such as vertical_1080p

transparentBackground.description: PNG only: true exports a transparent background

width.description: output width in pixels, 40 to 25000; PNG and JPG only

name: export_canva_design
title: Export a Canva design
